payload.title: EXAMPLE — account menu opens from the header
payload.errorMessage:
Timed out 10000ms waiting for expect(locator).toBeVisible()

Locator: getByTestId('nav-account-menu')
Expected: visible
Received: <element(s) not found>

note: EXAMPLE — not a real case, format illustration only. A timeout waiting for an element superficially reads as flaky (a common FLAKY shape), but zero prior failures in 40 runs plus a consistent-across-both-attempts 'not found' (not an intermittent visibility flicker) point to the test-id being renamed in a recent header refactor, not timing variance.
